def display_sample_count(traces: List[CallTrace], stderr: IO[str]) ->None:
    # Group traces by function name
    func_traces = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for trace in traces:
        func_traces[trace.func].append(trace)
    
    # Print sample count for each function
    for func, func_traces_list in func_traces.items():
        func_name = f"{func.__module__}.{func.__name__}"
        count = len(func_traces_list)
        print(f"Annotation for {func_name} based on {count} call trace(s).", file=stderr)
